integrity: Exact proof supplied, checked algebraic sign comparisons and reproducible standard-library supplemental checker; qualified publication priority, no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact phase diagram is for the unmodified Alexander two-stage L-stable DIRK end-step on unit-edge stars K_{1,m}, m>=2, only; no stagewise positivity, weighted-star or generic-graph extension. Source date is the earliest verified exact-date public electronic posting for Alexander (SIAM online 2006-07-14); the print publication is known to be in December 1977 without a verified day. Original publisher full text was inaccessible, but method coefficients and stability function were independently checked from publicly available method documentation.
title: Two forbidden timestep bands and their merger for Alexander SDIRK2 diffusion on stars
